feat: add opt-in action controls and clone cycle detection

* feat: add opt-in action controls and clone cycle detection

Non-breaking hardening for downloaded degit.json, which executes
unconditionally and is fully template-controlled:

- --no-actions flag and actions option skip degit.json actions after
  cloning; the count is logged either way
- --allow-env flag and allowEnv option restrict which environment
  variables search_replace may read; a bare flag allows none
- clone directives that re-enter a source already in the clone chain
  fail with CLONE_CYCLE instead of recursing forever
- search_replace warns when the env var name looks like a secret
- warn when a directive lists more than 1,000 files
- ignore the gitignored .tmp scratch dir in the no-more-docs lint rule
